nodes.name: POST zoho-sync Edge Function
nodes.notes: The Edge Function replies 202 immediately and runs the sync via EdgeRuntime.waitUntil, so a 30s node timeout is plenty. Run detail lands in zoho_sync_runs / zoho_sync_state (visible at /settings/zoho-sync).

meta.notes:
Replaces 62 — Zoho Live Sync (deleted 2026-07-16; wrong direction, called a nonexistent RPC). Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-16-zoho-live-api-sync-design.md.

PENDING MANUAL STEPS before activating:
1. Deploy the zoho-sync Edge Function (supabase functions deploy zoho-sync --no-verify-jwt).
2. Set the Zoho Edge secrets: pnpm tsx scripts/set-zoho-edge-secrets.ts --apply (reads ZOHO_* from .env.local; needs SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN).
3. Confirm SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY (sb_secret_*) env vars exist on the n8n droplet (/opt/shiroi-automation/.env) — force-recreate the container after edits.
4. Confirm N8N_EVENT_BUS_URL + N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET env vars exist (error path).
5. Import via pnpm tsx scripts/push-n8n-workflows.ts, then activate in the n8n UI (activation is a deliberate UI step — never flip active in JSON).
6. First cold pull converges over several 15-min cycles (page budget); watch /settings/zoho-sync.

Architecture:
- Every 15 min POST {"mode":"both"} → zoho-sync Edge Function (service-role Bearer)
- Function does voucher PUSH first, then inbound PULL for all 12 entities
- Function answers 202 and works in the background; failures of the HTTP call itself go to the ERP event bus as zoho_sync.error
